text:
aj: Quick postmortem follow-up — we've seen 5 partial-response incidents in the last 3 weeks hitting the streaming/chat endpoint. Pattern looks like intermittent client TCP resets + sporadic server tokenization stalls. Need concrete owners, deadlines, and a plan for recurring checks.

sasha: TL;DR of patterns: 1) short spikes of TCP resets during autoscale transitions; 2) tokenization outliers causing long-tail token latency (~>2s/token) when model shards warm; 3) clients sometimes re-create streams without resume tokens. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/streaming/reconnects (see panel: partial_response_rate).

maria: Action: create an alert: partial_responses_per_1k > 2 OR partial_response_rate > 0.2% sustained for 5m. I'll own alert creation + runbook link. ETA 2026-04-05.

darren: I'll own runtime reconnect/backoff changes. Current policy is a fixed 250ms retry which floods under burst. Plan: exponential backoff with jitter + circuit open on repeated 503s. ETA 2026-04-02. Proposed pseudo patch: 
```
// reconnect policy (runtime)
backoff = exponential(base=100ms, max=5s, jitter=0.2)
if consecutive_503s > 3: circuit.open(30s)
```
Will add metrics to track consecutive_503s and circuit_state.

kevin: I'll update client SDKs to support resume tokens and surface broken-stream metrics to users. Also add example snippets to quickstart. ETA 2026-04-06.

aj: Ops ask — can we run a 48h canary (10%) after Darren's patch lands? Need oncall monitoring plan.

eva-oncall: I'll run the canary smoke starting 2026-04-03 09:00Z and monitor the new alerts + partial_response_rate. Will post status back to #eng-sre every hour during the first 6h.

infra-bot: Deployment scheduled: refs/heads/darren/reconnect-backoff -> canary rollout at 2026-04-02T09:00Z. Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 1h pause and health checks. Linked PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/runtime/pull/432.

sasha: Also propose adding a recurring cadence: biweekly 60m "streaming reliability review" to look at partial_response trends, tokenization latency, and recent incident notes. Rotate primary owner between Runtime and SRE. Maria, can you create the calendar item once alerts are live?

maria: Will create the biweekly invite (60m) and add a stable agenda: metrics + recent incidents + regression tests. I'll have first meeting set by 2026-04-07.

aj: Consolidated owners & dates: 1) Alert + runbook (maria) by 2026-04-05; 2) Backoff/circuit change (darren) by 2026-04-02; 3) SDK resume + examples (kevin) by 2026-04-06; 4) Canary smoke (eva-oncall) 2026-04-03; 5) Recurring review calendar (maria) by 2026-04-07. I'll follow up in 72h to confirm progress.

kevin: Quick QA command to exercise resume path for QA/SEs: 
```
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream -d '{"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"hello"}], "enable_resume": true}'
```

darren: I'll add a new runtime metric tokenization_latency_p95 and tokenization_outlier_count so we can alert on long-tail stalls. infra-bot, pls ensure scraping and dashboards updated.

infra-bot: New metric registration requested by darren: tokenization_latency_p95, tokenization_outlier_count. Prometheus scrape config update ETA 2026-04-01. Dashboard panels will be auto-created when metrics are present.

eva-oncall: I'll post hourly canary updates during the first 6h and a summary at 24h. Will escalate to oncall lead if partial_response_rate > 0.5% sustained. :thumbsup:

aj: Thanks — once all items are closed I'll update the postmortem doc and mark remediation complete. Will link to this thread in the postmortem and the recurring calendar invite.

maria: tiny follow-up: make sure the runbook includes an "investigation checklist" with: logs to collect (runtime errors, client IP, tokenization stacktrace), dashboards to check, and example repro commands. I'll draft it after the alert lands.

sasha: One more thing — add a small regression test in CI that injects artificial tokenization delay to catch future regressions (runtime + model integration). Who can own? Darren?

darren: I can add an integration test scenario for tokenization delay. Target: 2 test cases (p50 normal, p95 injected 2s). ETA 2026-04-08.

aj: Great. I'll check back Friday. If anyone wants to reassign an item ping me here.

(ops-bot/system): Incident doc updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/streaming-partial-2026-03 (linked)
